meta.title: CNN Magic Wall: Interactive Weather
meta.description: How I introduced large-format multi-touch technology to CNN, brokered the partner relationship, and led the team that designed its interactive weather experience.

hero.label: CNN · Emerging Interaction
hero.title: Bringing Multi-Touch Storytelling to CNN
hero.subtitle: Introduced the large-format multi-touch platform to CNN, brokered the partner relationship, and led the team that designed its interactive weather experience.

context.challenge: Move CNN beyond limited touchscreen experiments toward an interaction model that could support live broadcast storytelling.
context.scope: Technology strategy, partner selection, product direction, and interaction design leadership
context.team: Turner R&D, CNN Weather, product design and engineering, and the external technology partner
context.body: CNN was evaluating multi-touch approaches that could not support the scale, responsiveness, or interaction model the network needed. I brought in a more capable large-format platform and brokered the relationship with the technology partner, drawing on a relationship I had established before the engagement. My team then designed and built CNN's interactive weather software. The election-night applications that later made the wall famous were produced by other CNN teams. They are part of the platform's adoption story, not work I claim as my team's software.

sections.label: The Product
sections.title: Weather was the experience my team built.
sections.description: The interface gave meteorologists a direct, spatial way to move through forecasts, storm systems, maps, and supporting data while staying connected to the audience. The work had to function as both an analytical tool and a live performance surface, with interactions clear enough to read instantly on television.
sections.imageAlt: CNN meteorologist presenting a hurricane forecast on the large-format interactive weather wall

sections.label: Platform Adoption
sections.title: The wall became part of CNN's visual language.
sections.description: This footage shows how CNN's election teams used the same class of large-format multi-touch platform for election-night storytelling. Their application was not built by my team. Its relevance here is the wider organizational adoption of the interaction model and partner technology I helped bring into CNN.
sections.caption: Election-night software shown for platform context; KC's team designed and built CNN's weather experience.

sections.label: The Leadership Move
sections.title: The intervention began before interface design.
sections.description: The decisive work was recognizing that the technology choices under consideration would constrain the experience, finding a platform capable of the interaction model, and creating the relationship that allowed CNN to adopt it. Product leadership here meant shaping the conditions in which good interaction design could exist.
